title: Savings baseline
summary: Tokens avoided by the Jev only show once there is a baseline to compare with.
usage: Tokens avoided = requests the Jev blocked × the average output of your last 200 answers that the tools reported. Until 20 reported answers exist, Statistics shows how many are missing instead of a number. The value is always an estimate and is never added to the real totals; to measure savings on your own project, run jayv bench.
